# Test fixtures

`ncc2025_v3_pages.pdf` holds four pages (70, 121, 205 and 209) of NCC 2025 Volume Three, the Plumbing Code of
Australia. The National Construction Code 2025 was provided by the Australian Building Codes Board under the
CC BY 4.0 licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). These pages are used unchanged as OCR ground
truth in `tests/test_eval_gate.py`.
